name: LOOP THE LOOP -Regeneration of Spin-
source:
The sequel to the mystery visual novel [url=/v32277]LOOP THE LOOP[/url]. The stage shifts from the Mansion to the "School" and the "Garden," deepening the mysteries of the system.

The story continues with the protagonist, Remi Kusunoki, as he delves closer to the truth behind the "Loop" and the entities that control it. With new encounters and a shifting reality, the characters must confront the "Spin" that governs their fates.

LOOP THE LOOP -Regeneration of Spin- is the second set of stories, comprising: 
- Houei no Hako
- Ishiro no Hime
- Yuumei no Utage
- Haguruma no Shima
- Hakuchuumu no Haka
